notes: Ludum Dare 55 game Pest Control by JereNurminen (https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/55/pest-control). Complete Unity 2023.2.17f1 project with playable Scene1 in EditorBuildSettings (SampleScene left disabled). GPL-3.0 at the repo-root LICENSE (standard GNU GPLv3 text). Official Unity packages only in Packages/manifest.json and packages-lock.json (all registry or builtin from packages.unity.com): 2D feature set (animation, Aseprite, pixel-perfect, PSD importer, sprite, SpriteShape, tilemap, tilemap extras), URP 16.0.5, Shader Graph, Timeline 1.8.6, uGUI, Visual Scripting 1.8.0, collab-proxy, IDE packages, test framework, macOS/Linux toolchain, and built-in modules. No TextMesh Pro, no bundled fonts, no DOTween, no EmojiOne, no FXAA, no Unity Standard Assets, no Asset Store packages, no LFS, no DLL. Sprites and WAV sounds in Assets/ appear to be original jam art; the repository contains no third-party asset credits. ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt is retained. ~9.9M src snapshot.
